title: Authenticate sites to the central lab with Prospectus-issued credentials re-verified by the lab
description: Decision (no earlier Cyclotron card existed; Papyrus PPY-58f107 only fixes lab-to-Prospectus auth): a site calls the lab with a short-lived Prospectus-issued credential for the selected account and role. The lab never trusts the pin or the token alone: it re-verifies the credential with the account service through an injected verifier on every operation, requires the verified account to equal the X-Cyclotron-Account pin, and derives grants through an injected function with no default role mapping. No shared lab API key, no long-lived key, no Prospectus client inside Cyclotron.
